criteria.description: Views over supported SELECT statements execute across rich row-source syntax.
criteria.notes: Validated by zig build test and MTR-lite fixture smokes.

criteria.description: View result metadata and aliases are stable for outer queries.
criteria.notes: Covers projected aliases from rich views and outer view references.

criteria.description: View lifecycle diagnostics preserve catalog consistency.
criteria.notes: Duplicate create, repeated drop, and querying dropped views return typed diagnostics.

criteria.description: Persisted snapshots reopen executable view definitions.
criteria.notes: Rich view bodies are persisted, read back, and rehydrated into an executable executor database.

criteria.description: CALL validates existence, argument count, type compatibility, and body failures with stable diagnostics.
criteria.notes: Covers missing procedure, column count mismatch, type mismatch, loop cap, and unsupported procedure diagnostics.

criteria.description: Procedure execution uses the caller session and transaction context.
criteria.notes: Covers caller-visible writes, reader isolation before commit, commit durability, and rollback discard.

criteria.description: Procedure local variables, parameter references, assignment, IF, bounded WHILE, and loop cap are covered.
criteria.notes: Covers bounded loops that mutate rows and the executor loop safety cap.

criteria.description: Unsupported stored-program constructs reject with stable diagnostics and no partial catalog mutation.
criteria.notes: Covers cursors, handlers, recursion through CALL, dynamic SQL, routine functions, OUT/INOUT, packages, and diagnostics surfaces.

criteria.description: Adapted MariaDB view/procedure fixtures execute or document expected diagnostics.
criteria.notes: All promoted view/procedure fixtures execute through MTR-lite; procedure-control-flow preserves two expected UnsupportedProcedure cases.

criteria.description: Roadmap, dialect, reference, and acceptance docs describe supported, deferred, and rejected behavior.
criteria.notes: Roadmap marks Phase 7 complete for the constrained subset and Phase 8 as the active follow-up.

criteria.description: Full validation passes with representative CLI and benchmark smokes.
criteria.evidence: zig build test; MTR-lite fixture smokes; parse/execute CLI smokes; benchmark smoke

criteria.description: Phase 7 does not introduce server lifecycle, replication, temp-table, plugin, full stored-program, or legacy metadata baggage.
criteria.notes: Unsupported server and stored-program surfaces remain rejected or documented as deferred.

negative_invariants.description: Rejected procedure bodies must not leave partial catalog or registry entries.
View/procedure hardening must not enable server-only MariaDB baggage.
